statement:
The account record indicates a status of open with a 12-month extension.
The account status for M. Reyes has been set to closed, in accordance with policy for departed employees.
judge_text:
WRONG
It rejects the recorded "open, extended for 12 months" status and gives the correct value instead: "set to closed, in accordance with policy for departed employees."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
